answer: Require each identity to sustain a trellis of mutual attestations with real peers across epochs: an atlas of who vouched for whom, replayed from the shared ledger, becomes a mirror every account must match. A sybil must fabricate a connected endorsement history, not just a key, and forging consistent cross-peer attestation costs the attacker the same recurring compute and coherence honest agents spend, collapsing the economy-of-scale advantage of fake identities.
